FREAKETONAS is back this Friday. 🚨🔥
DJ Ralphy-Ray takes the decks again — perreo, dembow, house, and Latin hits stitched together all night long, no breaks, no filler. 🎧
La pista doesn't warm up, it just arrives — and once Ralphy-Ray gets going, it doesn't let up till close. 💃🕺
This is week two of the Friday that's about to become Pasco's non-negotiable. Vibras latinas, every time. 🌟
Save the date, tell your friends, show up ready.

🗓️ Friday, November 13 | 9PM – Close
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💸 No Cover
🔞 21+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #Freaketonas #VibrasLatinas #DjRalphyRay #PascoWA #PerreoNight #LatinNight

The real reason FREAKETONAS hits different: the drinks. 🍬🥃
Mexican candy cocktails that taste like your childhood with a grown-up kick, tequila cocktails done right, and spiked horchata that's dangerously easy to drink. 🥤🔥
Mix that with DJ Ralphy-Ray on the decks, perreo and dembow rattling the speakers, and NO COVER all night — there's just no reason to be anywhere else this Friday. 💃
Grab your people, come thirsty, stay for la pista. 🙌
